items.heading: Always open source
items.body: Run the script to spin up your free, self-hosted instance in minutes. Ships with AI features. Used by millions worldwide.

items.heading: Connect your data and your tools
items.body: Query and visualize data from your database or warehouse. Work with your data via the MCP server, CLI, APIs, Slack, and more.

items.heading: Enterprise-grade security
items.body: We treat your data the way we'd want ours — it's secure and compliant (SOC1, SOC2, GDPR, CCPA, and more).

sections.heading: Analytics your team will use and trust
sections.standfirst: Teams can explore data on their own, guided to correct answers with a trustworthy foundation. Your data team can curate a governed semantic layer of canonical tables and metrics in Data Studio.

panels.heading: Query data in plain English with AI
panels.body: AI on all plans so anyone can explore data, visualize results, and answer their own questions. Ask Metabot AI or connect to the MCP server, click on charts to find the "why" with built-in drilldowns, or spin up a no-code query with the visual query builder.

panels.heading: Share reports and create custom insights
panels.body: Filter and breakout interactive dashboards. Combine charts with text in Documents for collaborative reporting. Set up subscriptions and alerts to keep everyone in the loop.

panels.heading: Guide people to the right answers
panels.body: Curate your semantic layer in Data Studio to make your data usable and correct for humans and AI. Define trusted, reusable metrics, and mark vetted data sources so everyone builds on consistent, accurate foundations.

sections.heading: Put production-grade analytics into your app without drama
sections.standfirst: Embed dashboards, visualizations, and self-serve reporting in your SaaS app. Multi-tenant, customizable analytics components, with plumbing and permissions built in.

items.heading: Way less engineering overhead than rolling your own in-app reporting
items.body: Data teams and non-technical teammates can work with data without bugging devs.

items.heading: Self-host or deploy on Metabase Cloud
items.body: Start with simple charts, embed full dashboards, or use the SDK for advanced setups as your needs grow.

items.heading: Customizable to fit your product
items.body: White-labeling, dynamic styling, and interactive controls from view-only to full data discovery with a low-code integration.

sections.heading: Metabase scales as you grow
sections.standfirst: Advanced features for managing lots of users and compliance. Flexible even as your tooling or workflow evolves.

seo.title: Roadmap | Metabase
seo.description: Highlights of what we're cooking: what is actively being built, what is planned for the next release or two, and what is coming in the next six months.

sections.heading: Highlights of what we're cooking

items.title: Explorations
items.body: A new way to work through your data, with AI alongside you rather than in the way.

items.title: Transform indexes
items.body: Create indexes on your transforms and keep them persisted between runs.

items.title: Treemaps
items.body: A new tree map chart type, for when a pie has too many slices to read.

items.title: Dashboard invites
items.body: Share a dashboard with someone outside Metabase in a single click.

items.title: PDFs in subscriptions
items.body: Attach a dashboard to a subscription as a PDF, not just inline images.

items.title: More AI providers
items.body: Support for Azure and AWS Bedrock models alongside the current providers.

groups.heading: Planned for the next release or two

items.title: Workspaces
items.body: Isolated data warehouse space for each agent, so one cannot disturb another.

items.title: Data apps
items.body: Custom applications built on top of the Metabase semantic layer.

items.title: Product analytics
items.body: Track and analyse product events natively, without a second tool to reconcile.

items.title: Content optimizer
items.body: Organise what already exists and surface the parts actually worth reading.

items.title: Transform improvements
items.body: Faster transforms, clearer error handling, and a number of smaller fixes.

items.title: Transform tests
items.body: Verification for the semantic layer, so a model can be trusted on sight.

items.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
items.body: Add support for two-factor authentication, where SSO is not the answer.

groups.heading: Coming in the next 6 months or so

items.title: Data catalog
items.body: Track lineage, PII and data quality, and help people find the right table.

items.title: Data warehouse cost insights
items.body: Know what your queries cost, and optimise or stop the expensive ones.

items.title: Mandatory filters and partition support
items.body: Require a filter on every GUI query, so partitioned tables stay affordable.

items.title: Permissions debugger
items.body: Troubleshoot permissions as an admin, and set them with more confidence.

items.title: Better control over auto-refresh
items.body: Pre-configured intervals, finer increments, and a clearer interface for both.

items.title: Better search UX
items.body: Easier access to filters, and a full results page worth landing on.

items.title: LLM-powered data extraction
items.body: Pull structure out of unstructured data, without writing the parser yourself.

items.title: More improvements to table viz
items.body: Column totals, multi-select, and much better handling of very wide tables.

items.title: Relative date expressions in SQL
items.body: More flexible date filters, expressed relative to when the query runs.

items.title: SQL editor improvements
items.body: Better ergonomics for the querying you actually do every day.

items.title: User and instance attributes in parameters
items.body: Reference things like user.email or instance.timezone in a query.

items.title: Dynamic goals
items.body: Define a goal line using another question, rather than a fixed number.
